This application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing of the entire proceedings, including

sentences.text: It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicants that the alleged dispute between the parties has taken place due to misconception and now both the parties have amicably settled the dispute and compromised the matter.
The informant and the victim of the case do not want to pursue the impugned proceedings.
It was further submitted that the victim was already a married lady and that she has already attained majority.
Now applicant no. 1 and victim have married with each other and they are residing together as husband and wife.
In her statement, recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., victim has stated that she wants to live with applicant no. 1 and that no foul act has been done against her.

In view of the statement of victim, recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.,
no case under Section 376 IPC is made out.
It was submitted that the compromise, filed by the parties before the trial court concerned, has already been verified by the court concerned, copy of which is also on record.

It was stated that in view of these facts and circumstances, no useful purpose would be served by keeping the impugned proceedings pending and thus, the impugned proceedings may be quashed on the basis of compromise arrived at between the parties.
4. Learned A.G.A. has no objection if parties compromise the matter.
5. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.
6. In the instant case perusal of record shows that essentially matter pertains to matrimonial dispute.
Victim was already a married lady and now she has performed marriage with applicant no.1 and they are residing together as husband and wife.
In her statement, recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., victim has stated that she wants to live with applicant no. 1 and that no foul act has been done against her.
In view of the statement of victim, recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C., no case under Section 376 IPC is made out.
Both the parties have compromised the case.
The compromise filed by the parties before the trial court, has already been verified by the court concerned.

Considering the law laid down in the case of State of Madhya Pradesh Vs. Laxmi Narayan and others, AIR 2019 SC 1296 and the facts of the matter, it would be in the interest of justice that the impugned proceedings be quashed, as the continuance of the same would be nothing but wastage of time of Court.

entities.text: State of Madhya Pradesh Vs. Laxmi Narayan and others, AIR 2019 SC 1296
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
7. In view of the aforesaid, the impugned charge-sheet and entire proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case against applicants, namely, Brijlal @ Vijay Lal, Rakesh and Bihari are, hereby,
quashed.
8. The application u/s 482 Cr.P.C. is allowed.
